card.name: Overdosage and component-level wording
card.fires_on: The word "individual" before "components" or "active substances" in overdosage sections, and scattered punctuation or linking words in label sentences about liver effects, drug interactions and hormone therapy.

modes.label: Individual components
modes.description: The word "individual" in overdosage text that refers to the separate ingredients of a combination drug.
modes.example: Overdosage information is based on experience with the<< individual>> components, dextromethorphan

modes.label: Punctuation in label sentences
modes.description: Commas, periods and colons ending a clause in interaction, hepatic or clinical-study statements.

modes.label: Hormone therapy wording
modes.description: The word "should" after "concurrently or" in prostate cancer dosing text.
modes.example: analog concurrently or<< should>> have had bilateral orchiectomy.
